extraction.notes: No summer 2027 or 2026 camp offerings could be verified from the supplied official pages or additional searches. Search results surfaced historical official camp announcements from 2015 and 2019 and a 2023 JROTC leadership camp flyer, but these are too old to supply 2026 fallback facts and were not turned into cards. The 2019 announcement names PHS Black Bear Softball Camp and PHS Black Bear Basketball Camp. Additional official pages could not be opened directly because the school website blocks browsing through robots.txt; indexed official search results were checked instead. This result does not establish that the school offers no camps.
